Native Canvas Interaction: live Editor geometry <-> semantic controller checkpoints
|-- Mounted boundary: MappingEditorCanvas(session)
|   |-- Consumes CanvasSession.controller from [workspace]
|   |-- Tldraw Editor owns live shapes, camera and native undo navigation
|   |-- MappingEditorRuntime translates between Editor and controller
|   `-- CanvasRuntime owns renderer-local models, anchors, focus and routing
|-- Semantic state -> native projection
|   |-- Controller snapshot -> projectMappingShapes -> create/update/delete shapes
|   |   |-- Grid placement in cells -> parent-relative pixel geometry
|   |   `-- Visible floating nodes, edges and side panels -> native shapes
|   |-- Display-node identity -> mappingShapeId -> stable shape correspondence
|   |-- Same checkpoint while pointing -> defer projection
|   |   `-- Idle tick settles native changes before applying pending projection
|   `-- New checkpoint -> record projected shapes + checkpoint reference together
|       `-- Sync/settle/navigation guards prevent projection feedback loops
|-- Native interaction -> semantic settlement
|   |-- Shape or native selection change -> mark dirty
|   |   `-- Tick waits until pointing, dragging and pinching have stopped
|   |-- Settle compares live shapes with their last projection
|   |   |-- Grid movement -> page bounds -> rounded, nonnegative cell coordinates
|   |   |-- Floating move/resize -> display geometry and manual placement
|   |   `-- Supported diagram clones -> duplicate-instance; unsupported copies removed
|   |-- Changed geometry -> controller.commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas)
|   |   `-- Handoff to [canvas_commands] for semantic checkpoint handling
|   |       `-- This boundary commits semantic changes; it does not acknowledge storage
|   `-- Selection ownership preserves application meaning
|       |-- Native selection adds diagram IDs for dragging
|       |-- Explicit application gestures change selected content membership
|       `-- Pending application projection suppresses native selection capture
|-- Native undo/redo <-> semantic checkpoint archive
|   |-- canvasRevisionId identifies a canvas checkpoint
|   |   `-- Stored as document.meta.mappingCheckpoint alongside the shape diff
|   |-- Hydration replays checkpoint references and materializes current shapes
|   |   `-- Historical geometry is projected when navigation restores its checkpoint
|   |-- Undo/redo completes interaction and settles before navigating Editor history
|   |   `-- Canvas transfer transaction -> reject local navigation; require workspace undo/redo
|   `-- Synchronous checkpoint observer -> controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint(id)
|       `-- Reproject restored state without recording another history step
|-- Renderer-local geometry supports responsive connections
|   |-- Controller snapshots -> per-ID render models
|   |   `-- Preserve equal model branches so unrelated edits do not invalidate readers
|   |-- Connection focus consumes revision-scoped content nodes from [parsing]
|   |   |-- Match displayNodeId + contentNodeId + content.revisionId
|   |   |   `-- Content revision identifies anchor content, not the canvas checkpoint
|   |   `-- Validate membership; clear stale focus on revision/selection change or edge removal
|   |-- LocalAnchorStore retains shape-local endpoint measurements
|   |   |-- Use only measurements matching the owner's current layoutKey
|   |   |-- Layout changes/font loads invalidate; removed owners lose records
|   |   `-- Camera movement and DOM culling preserve measurements
|   `-- NativeRoutingStore consumes endpoints + world-space obstacles
|       |-- Obstacles: matching local measurements or content-derived geometry
|       |   `-- Editor shape transforms place obstacles in page coordinates
|       |-- During drag -> preview using the last settled route
|       |-- After drag -> route current geometry; preview while worker is pending
|       |   `-- One job in flight + newest pending request; discard stale results
|       |-- No worker or worker failure -> synchronous ConnectionRouter
|       |   `-- Pure routing/cache and lane spacing, also usable by headless callers
|       `-- Routing reads no DOM, writes no document and has no camera dependency
|-- Camera and application controls have separate paths
|   |-- Camera reactor -> overlay DOM transform without application React state
|   |-- Changed camera -> captureViewCamera + callback, outside gesture commits
|   |   `-- Checkpoint change with saved viewport -> restore Editor camera
|   `-- Application controls retain semantic delete, source-aware paste and content selection
`-- Detach releases mounted resources
    |-- MappingEditorRuntime.dispose -> complete interaction, settle, unsubscribe
    |-- Remove camera/font/pointer listeners and unregister selection tools
    `-- Disconnect CanvasRuntime subscription; clear Editor reference
        `-- Terminate routing worker and clear queued jobs and settled results
